items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: they think of the Austin High School Band and they think of Teschemacher and Eddie Condon and Bud Freeman and Benny Goodman

ctx.x: Okay -- so, you had that one record, but can we throw in something -- a lot of people when they heard you in Chicago - they think of the Austin High School Band and they think of Teschemacher and Eddie Condon and Bud Freeman and Benny Goodman -- and all those guys; they were just about to get ready to start along about this time -- the same time Earl Hines was coming into Chicago---
